name: Jericho

related_people.name: Abiram
related_people.role: Hiel's firstborn, who died when his father refounded this city

related_people.name: Achan
related_people.role: took plunder devoted to destruction from this city, bringing defeat on Israel

related_people.name: Amasa
related_people.role: an Ephraimite leader who saw Judah's captives clothed and returned to this city

related_people.name: Bartimaeus
related_people.role: the blind beggar of this city, healed as Jesus was leaving it

related_people.name: Eglon
related_people.role: the Moabite king who seized “the city of palms” and its region

related_people.name: Hiel
related_people.role: rebuilt this city under Ahab, losing two sons as Joshua had cursed

related_people.name: Rahab
related_people.role: the prostitute of this city who hid the spies and was spared when it fell

related_people.name: Segub
related_people.role: Hiel's youngest son, who died when his father set up this city's gates

related_people.name: Zaccheus
related_people.role: the chief tax collector of this city who climbed a tree to see Jesus

description: One of the world's oldest cities, Jericho was the first Canaanite city Israel conquered after crossing the Jordan — its walls falling after Israel marched around it seven days as God had instructed, following the spies' earlier reception by Rahab (Joshua 2; 6). Centuries later Elijah and Elisha passed through it near the Jordan (2 Kings 2:4-8), and it was near Jericho that Jesus healed blind Bartimaeus and called the tax collector Zacchaeus down from his tree (Mark 10:46-52; Luke 19:1-10).
